an4.112:1.1: catūhi bhikkhave aṅgehi samannāgato rañño bhadro assājānīyo rājāraho hoti rājabhoggo. rañño aṅgantveva saṅkhaṃ gacchati.
an4.112:1.4: imehi kho bhikkhave catūhi aṅgehi samannāgato rañño bhadro assājānīyo rājāraho hoti rājabhoggo. rañño aṅgantveva saṅkhaṃ gacchati.
an4.112:2.1: evameva kho bhikkhave catūhi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu āhuneyyo hoti pāhuneyyo, dakkhiṇeyyo, añjalikaraṇīyo anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassa.
an4.112:2.4: imehi kho bhikkhave catūhi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu āhuneyyo hoti …pe… anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassāti.
